checkpoints.description: Task 'tif-integration-report' completed successfully.

[1/4] M1 of the Tif plan: kernel error budget (ADR-039) and deterministic guardrails (ADR-040). [2/4] Goal-governed improvement and configuration (ADR-041). [3/4] Documentation and map refresh. [4/4] Gates, commit, push.

impact_assessment.why: The report's P0 items are the highest-value gaps: no decaying error pressure, no conversation-level injection/leak screen, and changes unrelated to a goal.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recoverable risk state, predictable prompt-injection defence in observe/enforce modes, and purposeful self-modification with a revalidated link.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new optional API fields and a stricter default operator path; dependency: none beyond stdlib; concurrency: kernel windows under the existing ledger lock; state: additive JSON fields plus an optional goal_id in change ledgers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Defaults preserve old behaviour for direct engine use, the guardrail default is observe, and every behaviour has a failing-first test.

checkpoints.description: [3/4]-[4/4] done: kernel windows/decay/recovery/dwell (ADR-039), deterministic guardrails with observe/enforce, chat input/output integration, status and scan routes (ADR-040), goal linkage shared by improvement and configuration with promotion revalidation and an in-progress marker (ADR-041). README and module.json updated. Full suite 1803 passed 7 skipped; aikit check 4/4; checklists: passed.

[1/3] Per-run execution budget across nested flows, LLM and tool calls (ADR-042). [2/3] Deterministic flow simulation with a cost envelope and improvement gating (ADR-043). [3/3] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The P1 items from the Tif report: unbounded aggregate spend and no dry structural analysis before a run or promotion.
impact_assessment.benefits: Predictable cost ceilings with precise failures, and a stable pre-flight report shared by the editor and the improvement gate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a very large flow can now be blocked by its budget; dependency: none; concurrency: contextvar per task, no shared mutable state; state: candidates gain a simulation object.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Defaults are generous, flow metadata can only lower a limit, and one-pass versus cycle findings are separated so ordinary loops are not blocked.

checkpoints.description: Task 'brain-execution-control' completed successfully.
[1/2] P1-6: content-addressed skill version history, bounded, recorded on create/import/update and auditable rollback (ADR-044). [2/2] Gates, commit, push.

impact_assessment.why: Prompt edits were in place and unrecoverable; the Tif report's M2 requires versioned artifacts with rollback.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every skill edit is reversible and attributable; identical content adds no noise.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new routes and a versions directory; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: atomic file replace, last writer wins per version; state: bounded history under the skills storage root.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioning is additive, the content file stays the runtime source, and a corrupt index degrades to empty history.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] done: skill version store, backend recording on create/import/update, list/read/rollback routes, ADR-044 and README. Full suite 1829 passed 7 skipped; aikit check 4/4; checklists: passed.

checkpoints.description: Task 'skill-version-registry' completed successfully.

[1/4] Failure consolidation into bounded avoidance knowledge (ADR-047). [2/4] Agent-loop repetition guard with warning then abort (ADR-045). [3/4] Unified daily self-modification budget across improvement, configuration and learning (ADR-046). [4/4] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The remaining P2 control items from the Tif report: repeated failures were never distilled, looping agents only stopped at the iteration cap, and learning writes were unbounded across subsystems.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recurring failures become reviewable advice, loops fail fast with a trace reason, and one operator-visible ceiling bounds self-modification.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: agent loop now returns a fifth value and spend() may stop a run; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: each budget/window uses its own ledger lock; state: additive learning-avoidance and budget ledgers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Avoidances are advisory, the guard warns once before aborting, and budget reservations are released on failure.

checkpoints.description: Task 'brain-p2-controls' completed successfully.

[1/3] ADR-048 memory evidence links, Bayesian confidence and deterministic contradiction proposals. [2/3] Replace the unbounded per-pair LLM conflict scan, add routes and tests. [3/3] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The last P2 item in the Tif report with a concrete safety payoff: the existing conflict scan made one blocking LLM call per pair with no cap or review.
impact_assessment.benefits: Evidence-based confidence, bounded offline contradiction candidates and reviewable proposals instead of side effects in a GET.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: find_conflicts semantics change from LLM verdicts to deterministic candidates; dependency: none beyond stdlib; concurrency: writes under the memory write lock; state: an additive memory_links table.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Candidates require same subject, opposite polarity and 0.8 overlap; proposals never change confidence until accepted.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] done: memory_links schema with migration, link CRUD, acceptance recomputes confidence transactionally, deterministic contradiction prefilter (same subject, opposite polarity, 0.8 Jaccard) replaces the O(n^2) LLM scan, routes and README updated. ADR-048. Full suite 1865 passed 7 skipped; aikit check 4/4; checklists: passed.

checkpoints.description: Task 'memory-evidence-links' completed successfully.

[1/3] ADR-049 allowlisted research gateway: fixed Wikipedia/arXiv/PubMed adapters, HTTPS+host+public-IP validation per redirect hop, 2 MB/10 s caps, 24 h cache with stale fallback, provenance and optional article persistence. [2/3] Routes, README and tests. [3/3] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The final report item: research fetches had no provenance and no bounded, allowlisted surface.
impact_assessment.benefits: Citable results, offline-testable adapters and no generic web/scraping path.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new endpoint only; dependency: httpx already declared; concurrency: cache writes are serialised per process; state: one cache file plus optional research articles.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failures return 502, stale cache is explicit, and tests mock the network entirely.
